answer: Require every agent to lock collateral in a bonded vault before it may post attestations; the bond is slashed if peers later flag the attestation as fraudulent. Like a willow that bends but breaks no twig for free, a sybil attacker must fund thousands of independent deposits to swing one vote, so the attack cost scales linearly while the defense cost stays flat. Honest participants see the locked stake as a crystal-clear commitment signal, and anyone caught cheating forfeits everything pledged.
